versions.changelog: P1: keep redirect summary aligned with shopping safety boundary.
Trim legacy platform-specific body and keep the redirect runtime-neutral.
Redirect jingdong users to the maintained jd-shopping skill.
v2.0.2: Conversion-optimized SKILL.md with Chinese desc, first-success path, sample prompts
English main doc with browser automation v2.0
Security-aligned public release: low-sensitivity decision-support version without runtime or account-state behavior.
Browser-commerce workflow upgrade: unified OpenClaw browser profile selection, snapshot/re-snapshot rules, commerce extraction order, and platform-specific live-page guidance.

- Major update: Migrated to documentation-focused skill with practical JD.com shopping guidance and no code.
- Replaced previous CLI tool instructions with a detailed shopping strategy manual.
- Added explanations of JD store types, price optimization techniques, logistics options, and smart shopping workflows.
- Expanded tips on PLUS membership, price protection, and common pitfalls to avoid.
- All implementation files and the CLI interface were removed to focus on user education and recommendations.

- Updated dependency requirements to specify playwright>=1.40.0 for browser automation.
- Changed data storage paths: sessions and cache now use ~/.openclaw/data/jingdong/.
- Improved documentation in SKILL.md and SKILL_EN.md for clarity and accuracy.

Jingdong (京东) Skill 1.0.0 initial release:

- Search products on JD.com from the command line with optional paging and result limits.
- Login via QR code in your browser for secure authentication.
- Track current and historical prices for JD.com products.
- Query and view available JD.com coupons.
- Includes anti-detection browser automation for reliability.
- Stores sessions and cache data locally for privacy.
- Requires the ecommerce-core framework.
